title: Applicability-gated ITU-R P.1411-13 Table 4 candidate models

reference.name: ITU-R P.1411-13
reference.scope_note: The recommendation's main scope reaches 300 GHz, but individual Table 4 rows and footnotes gate frequency, distance, morphology, rooftop relation, and LoS/NLoS scenario separately.

equation.expression: Lb(d,f) = 10 alpha log10(d) + beta + 10 gamma log10(f) dB
equation.distance_definition: d is 3D direct distance between terminals in metres
equation.statistical_term: The source describes additive zero-mean Gaussian N(0, sigma) variation; this implementation reports sigma metadata and never samples it.

candidate_rows.frequency_distance_rule: Footnote (1): up to 500 m for 82 < f <= 159 GHz, 250 m for 159 < f <= 255 GHz, and 155 m for 255 < f <= 300 GHz; otherwise use the Table 4 nominal maximum.
candidate_rows.statistical_interpretation: Median/basic transmission loss; sigma is a zero-mean Gaussian variation descriptor, not an automatic margin.
limitations: No extrapolation beyond 500 m at 140 GHz
No atmospheric, wall, diffraction, material, or receiver-threshold term

candidate_rows.frequency_distance_rule: Footnote (2): up to 150 m for 82 < f <= 159 GHz; otherwise use the Table 4 nominal maximum.
candidate_rows.statistical_interpretation: Median/basic transmission loss; sigma is a zero-mean Gaussian variation descriptor, not an automatic margin.
limitations: No extrapolation beyond 150 m at 140 GHz

candidate_rows.frequency_distance_rule: Footnote (3): up to 150 m for 73 < f <= 159 GHz and 80 m for 159 < f <= 255 GHz; otherwise use the Table 4 nominal maximum.

strict_gates.frequency: Candidate frequency range and current-frequency footnote envelope are both required.
strict_gates.distance: The 3D direct/slant distance is checked against the current-frequency effective envelope; out-of-range results have no median path loss.
strict_gates.morphology: Unknown or non-row morphology is inapplicable; no urban taxonomy is inferred from density or footprint counts.
strict_gates.rooftop_relation: All supported rows require explicit both_below_rooftop. One-above/one-below, both-above, and unknown are not inferred or extrapolated.
strict_gates.los_state: The caller must declare LoS or NLoS. The existing 4F.1 classifier is not silently mapped into a P.1411 row.
strict_gates.provenance: Frequency and endpoint heights default to user_declared; distance defaults to geometry_derived; scenario facts default to unknown and therefore remain inapplicable until explicitly sourced or declared.

comparison_policy.p525: Exact wavelength-form P.525 FSPL is shown at the same 3D distance. excess_relative_to_fspl_db = P1411 median - P525 FSPL; it is not added.
comparison_policy.atmospheric_reference: The 4I.2A P.676/P.838/P.840 ledger is deferred by default and available only as an explicit comparison_only calculation; it is never summed.
comparison_policy.research_sub_thz: The current research_sub_thz 80 dB wall-event planning profile is an explicit alternative comparison only; it is never summed.
comparison_policy.p526: The existing P.526 diagnostic remains a separate path-profile diagnostic and is not invoked.
comparison_policy.canonical: No canonical model dispatch, coverage, interference, radio quality, building entry, or optimization path calls this evaluator.

automatic_applicability.reason: The current pack has no morphology taxonomy and no dataset-proven both-below-rooftop relation. Generic 25 m/1.5 m defaults and fallback-only heights are not roof evidence.
automatic_applicability.interpretation: The 432 paths are readiness evidence, not 140 GHz coverage or candidate-link validation. User-declared scenario provenance is the supported 4I.2B workflow.

distance_readiness.note: The audit radius is within the LoS maximum but does not make NLoS paths eligible; exact morphology/rooftop/LOS-conditioned counts were not fabricated.

deferred_work: Explicit site-general morphology taxonomy and rooftop relation evidence
Terrestrial atmospheric profile integration and weather provenance
Optional material/interface and diffraction studies, kept separate from P.1411 empirical rows
No current claim of canonical 140 GHz coverage or radio-quality support
